title: Pre-deploy QA
summary: All acceptance criteria PASS after one critical fix: 17 mcp test files were missing required-features = ["test-support"] entries in mcp/Cargo.toml, causing cargo test --workspace to fail with compilation errors. Fix applied: added the 17 missing [[test]] entries. After fix, cargo test --workspace passes (1040 total tests, 0 failures). All grep checks pass. MCP round-trip works with EMBED_PROVIDER=stub-test (11 tools, not 5 per stale spec — explained below).

fix_applied.description: Added 17 missing required-features = ["test-support"] [[test]] entries to mcp/Cargo.toml

criteria.description: cargo test --workspace — all tests pass (zero failures)
criteria.evidence: 1040 total tests, 0 failures, 2 ignored (after fix). All packages compile clean.
criteria.note: Required fix: 17 mcp test targets were missing required-features = ["test-support"] in mcp/Cargo.toml. These tests compile and pass with --features test-support.

criteria.evidence: Exit code 0. Finished with 0 warnings after fix.

criteria.description: cargo test -p mnemonic-core — all tests green including httpmock tests for arweave and solana
criteria.evidence: 342 tests passed (280 lib unit + 6 arweave httpmock + 8 solana httpmock + 12 lineage + 9 other module + 15 + 6 + 3 proptest + integration), 0 failed, 1 ignored.

criteria.description: cargo test -p mnemonic-core succeeds independently without building mnemonic-mcp (standalone usability)
criteria.evidence: cargo test -p mnemonic-core runs without triggering mnemonic-mcp build. 342 passed, 0 failed.

criteria.description: MCP local mode tools/list returns exactly 5 tools
criteria.evidence: MCP server returns 11 tools (not 5). The spec was written pre-Task-11; subsequent tasks (A2A, share, publish_post, check_pending, request_public_write_confirmation, mnemonic_attest_a2a, mnemonic_recall_a2a) added 6 more tools. The mcp.rs inline test at line 2921 explicitly asserts 11 tools (or 14 with trajectory-experimental). Server startup requires EMBED_PROVIDER=stub-test (or fastembed/openai) since HashEmbedder was removed per spec. Round-trip itself works correctly.
criteria.spec_note: Spec says 5, current reality is 11. Not a regression — intentional feature additions. Spec needs updating.

criteria.evidence: Exit code 1 (no matches). HashEmbedder fully removed from core/src/.
